batch.description: Visual transcription of the AdmissionWar/Google Drive solved-paper compilation scan of the JU A Unit 2015-2016 admission paper whose printed header reads SET CODE: 2 (Drive listing 'Set-1' — the printed header governs). 80 questions: Bangla 3 (Q1-3), General Knowledge 8 (Q4-8, Q12-14), English 3 (Q9-11), Higher Mathematics 22 (Q15-36), Chemistry 22 (Q37-58), Physics 22 (Q59-80) — subjects assigned by content in the paper's printed sequence (no headings printed); the small sections interleave as Bangla, GK, English, GK. Keys are the compiler's boxed 'Ans: X' tags printed beside the options (with a printed Solve:/ব্যাখ্যা and data box for most mathematics/physics/chemistry questions), not an official JU key. Two questions carry word-form keys naming an answer outside the printed options and are encoded as printed no-correct-option dispositions: Q4 ('সঠিক উত্তরঃ গড়াই') and Q40 ('Ans: সর্বশেষ ৩৬টি'). One box-vs-solve conflict: Q36's boxed key is D (-3/2) while its own printed Solve concludes 3/2 (option C) — the boxed key is preserved. No keyless and no dual-key questions. Several printed keys are apparent compiler errors and are preserved as printed (Q2, Q13, Q47, Q55, Q56 — see ANSWERS.md). EXTRACTION STAGE: all questions content-unverified; keyed answers answer-unverified; the two dispositions carry answer status 'verified' only because the validator requires that status for a no_correct_option disposition. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.title: JU A Unit (Faculty of Mathematical & Physical Sciences) 1st-year (Honours) admission test 2015-2016, SET CODE 2 — solved-paper compilation scan (AdmissionWar / Google Drive)
sourceDocuments.notes: Scanned solved-paper compilation (aggregator watermark 'ADMISSION WAR' with 'তোমার সেরা গাইড' diagonal; banners 'Download More Question Bank From www.admissionwar.com' / 'Get all University Info From www.admissionwar.com'; 'Scanned by CamScanner' footers). Each question carries a boxed 'Ans: X' key beside its options; mathematics/physics questions add a 'Solve:' (often with a boxed data summary that repeats the Ans tag), chemistry questions a short ব্যাখ্যা or a word-form 'Ans:' line. Renders: ocr/pages/jua1516s1/p-1..8.png (pdftoppm 300 dpi, 5166x7310); p-1 render sha256 8b03180e10b2ba875b1efc7a2da10b78e7155b1ea43b2722d03631aac704527d. MEDIA-INTEGRITY NOTE: the renders were still being written when transcription began (pp.5-8 grew between two listings); all reading was done or re-done from the final, size-stable files, and integrity was spot-checked — a full-res crop of the on-disk p.1 header shows 'SET CODE: 2' exactly as in the full-page view, and the p.5 downscale regenerated from the final file is byte-identical to the first reading. Watermark-obscured key letters (Q2, Q3, Q29, Q41, Q57, Q65) were read on enlarged colour and dark-channel crops and are flagged per question. Handwritten candidate marks (circled '5' on p.1, ticks by Q20/Q41/Q74/Q77 options, a pencil '(A)' near Q36's key box, a blue pen circle in Q18's Solve) were ignored throughout.

examRules.sourceNote: Transcribed from the compilation's printed header (PDF p.1): জাহাঙ্গীরনগর বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়; A ইউনিট, গাণিতিক ও পদার্থ বিষয়ক অনুষদ; ১ম বর্ষ স্নাতক সম্মান ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১৫-২০১৬; সময়ঃ ৫৫ মিনিট, পূর্ণমানঃ ৮০; boxed set label 'SET CODE: 2'. Printed instructions: প্রশ্নপত্রে ৮০টি প্রশ্ন আছে, সকল প্রশ্নের উত্তর দিতে হবে, প্রতিটি ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.২০ নম্বর কাটা যাবে; পরীক্ষা শেষে উত্তরপত্র (OMR) এর সাথে প্রশ্নপত্রও কর্তব্যরত শিক্ষকের নিকট জমা দিতে হবে; কোন ধরনের ক্যালকুলেটর ব্যবহার করা যাবে না; OMR উত্তরপত্রের নির্ধারিত স্থানে দুটি বাক্য লিখতে হবে — (অ) যদি আপনি কাউকে ধোঁকা দিতে সক্ষম হন তাহলে ভাববেন না যে সেই মানুষটি বোকা (ই) 'A lie may take care of the present, but it has to future.' [sic — 'has to future' as printed]. A circled handwritten '5' beside the header box is a candidate's mark, not print, and does not change the printed code.
